note: Manually curated, dated market snapshot. Each entry was independently verified against its primary source before publication. This is not a live feed — review and refresh quarterly.

items.claim: Overall organizational AI adoption reached 88%, and generative AI specifically is used in at least one business function at 70% of organizations.
71% of organizations report regularly using generative AI in at least one business function, up from 65% a year earlier.
items.source: McKinsey & Company, "The State of AI" Global Survey

items.claim: Across OECD countries, only 11.9% of firms with 10-49 employees use AI, compared to 40% of firms with 250+ employees — small businesses adopt AI far more slowly than large ones.
items.source: OECD, "AI adoption by small and medium-sized enterprises" (G7 discussion paper)

items.claim: 75% of retail decision-makers (three out of four) say AI agents will be essential to stay competitive within a year, per a survey of 1,700 retail leaders across 21 countries.
61% of global B2C retail decision-makers plan to implement agentic AI within the next 12 months, and 42% plan to increase search spend in 2026, per Algolia's eCommerce search report.
items.source: Algolia, 6th Annual eCommerce Search Report (industry/vendor survey)

items.claim: Real estate agents are adopting AI fast — roughly 79% now use it daily, weekly, or occasionally (per NAR's category breakdown), most commonly for listing descriptions (75%), social media posts (56%), and follow-up emails (52%).
items.source: National Association of REALTORS®, 2026 Technology Report

items.claim: Organization-wide AI usage in professional services nearly doubled to 40% in 2026 (from 22% in 2025) — though only 18% of firms track AI ROI in any way.
items.source: Thomson Reuters, 2026 AI in Professional Services Report

items.claim: Nepal ranks 150th of 193 countries on AI readiness, and only 31.8% of Nepali businesses report having an AI budget.
items.source: Zunkiree Labs' own analysis, "State of AI in Nepal 2026"
